chunks: And We certainly chose them over the worlds with knowledge.
ai.seo_question: Who were chosen by God with knowledge in Surah Ad-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine selection of the Ahl al-Bayt and Imams, emphasizing that their superiority stems from innate, divinely bestowed knowledge ('Ilm) rather than mere human merit. This selection underscores their role as the ultimate authorities in guiding the 'Alamin (all of humanity), linking their spiritual authority directly to God's wisdom.
